title: Falcon

description.en: Native macOS Jev proxy and decision observability, in development
description.zh: 开发中的 macOS 原生 Jev 代理与决策观察应用

subject: Multicolored fragmented peregrine falcon head entering from the left

subject.en: Multicolored fragmented peregrine falcon head entering from the left
subject.zh: 从左侧入框的多彩碎片化游隼头部

description.en: The peregrine head enters from the left, leaving broad negative space to the right. Its dark facial markings, golden eye ring and hooked beak carry the identity.
description.zh: 游隼头部从左侧入框，右侧保留大幅留白。深色面纹、金色眼圈与钩状喙共同构成识别特征。

description.en: Connected flat facets follow the blue-gray crown and cream cheek, with gold and burgundy accents. The head remains the focal point.
description.zh: 连贯的平面切面沿灰蓝冠羽与奶油色面颊展开，穿插金色与酒红点缀，视觉集中于头部。

description.en: Sparse cliff grasses sit in the right-hand negative space on cool slate paper. The habitat geometry and shadows are separate from the transparent head.
description.zh: 稀疏崖边草叶置于右侧留白与冷灰蓝纸色之上，栖息地纹样和阴影与透明头部分离。

palette.source: artwork/logo-family/falcon/2026-09-25-03/presentation.json background.base; authored presentation, not a website token

sizeNote.en: Use the transparent head at 24/16px without an extra tile or mask. The head silhouette and beak remain the main cues; individual color facets soften at these sizes.
sizeNote.zh: 24/16px 使用透明头部，不添加底板或遮罩。头部轮廓与鸟喙是主要识别线索，独立色彩切面会在小尺寸下柔化。

palette.source: Canonical logo.png at aa0e050e0f53b09d0cbfd088ed957cb74112e3dc; transparent canvas verified in the selected finishing

source.description: Native macOS Jev proxy and decision observability, in development

goal.en: A native macOS application in development for routing local Agent requests to Jev and inspecting their decisions. Its design connects each source, request context, returned answer and usage record, with seven-day local retention. The preserved local source includes the Swift application foundation; no public application release is claimed.
goal.zh: 正在开发的 macOS 原生应用，用于转发本机 Agent 的 Jev 请求并查看决策。设计将调用来源、请求上下文、返回答案与用量关联起来，在本机保留七天记录。已保存的本地源码包含 Swift 应用基础，尚不宣称已有公开应用版本。

role.en: Native macOS application and interface under development
role.zh: 开发中的 macOS 原生应用与界面

role.en: Local HTTP and MCP proxy architecture
role.zh: 本机 HTTP 与 MCP 代理架构

description.en: Authored quiet habitat foliage, independent of the approved bird foreground.
description.zh: 独立于已批准鸟类前景的安静栖地叶片纹样。

alt.en: Multicolored fragmented peregrine falcon head entering from the left on a Hexly campaign canvas
alt.zh: 从左侧入框的多彩碎片化游隼头部，置于 Hexly 宣发画布

description.zh: 偏心构图的多彩游隼头部。

description.en: Preserve the exact project identity and the separately recorded Hexly artwork. Hexly paper, ink and terracotta belong to archive and campaign surfaces only; independent product palettes and themes stay their own.
description.zh: 项目原标与单独记录的 Hexly 主视觉均保持形状和原色。Hexly 纸色、墨色和陶土色只用于档案及宣发画布，各产品色板与主题独立保留。

description.en: Keep the existing portrait's natural frame entry. The full square is placed against the baseline; no anatomy is extended, trimmed or masked. Keep external clear space of at least 1/8 of the mark canvas height around standalone marks and lockups. Wide and mobile Heroes are separate compositions of existing artwork, with no image-model call.
description.zh: 保留原头像自然入框的边界，将完整方形画布贴齐基线；不补画、不截取解剖结构。独立标志及字标组合四周，至少留出标志画布高度 1/8 的外部净空。宽幅与手机 Hero 分别排版，没有新图像模型调用。

description.en: Navigation 24px preferred, 16px minimum. Wordmark ≥78px wide; lockup ≥160px. Use transparent PNG/ICO at small sizes without a tile, extra red dot, shadow or rounded mask. Fine facets soften at 16px.
description.zh: 导航推荐 24px，最小 16px。字标宽度至少 78px，组合至少 160px。小尺寸使用透明 PNG/ICO，不加底板、红点、阴影或圆角遮罩；16px 时细小切面会柔化。
